<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>for yayang</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,400;0,9..144,500;1,9..144,400&family=Inter:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --cream: #FBF4EE;
    --blush: #F3D6D9;
    --lavender: #E2D9EE;
    --plum: #4E3F52;
    --plum-soft: #7A6B7E;
    --gold: #D9A88F;
    --paper: #FFFDFB;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; }

  html, body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    min-height: 100%;
  }

  body {
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    color: var(--plum);
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 15%, var(--blush) 0%, transparent 45%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 85% 80%, var(--lavender) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--cream);
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 24px;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  .card {
    max-width: 560px;
    width: 100%;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 56px 40px;
  }

  .mark {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    margin: 0 auto 28px;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: rise 0.9s ease-out 0.1s forwards;
  }

  .mark svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }

  h1 {
    font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 8vw, 4rem);
    line-height: 1.05;
    margin: 0 0 36px;
    color: var(--plum);
    opacity: 0;
    animation: rise 0.9s ease-out 0.3s forwards;
  }

  /* Button */
  .reveal-btn {
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--paper);
    background: var(--gold);
    border: none;
    padding: 16px 34px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    cursor: pointer;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    touch-action: manipulation;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    appearance: none;
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(217, 168, 143, 0.35);
    transition: transform 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: rise 0.9s ease-out 0.55s forwards;
  }

  .reveal-btn:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(217, 168, 143, 0.45);
    background: #CE9A7D;
  }

  .reveal-btn:active {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  .reveal-btn:focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--plum);
    outline-offset: 3px;
  }

  /* Revealed content */
  .reveal-content {
    display: none;
  }

  .reveal-content.show {
    display: block;
  }

  .message {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    line-height: 1.75;
    color: var(--plum-soft);
    max-width: 440px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: rise 0.7s ease-out 0.05s forwards;
  }

  .message + .message {
    margin-top: 18px;
  }

  /* Polaroid strip */
  .polaroids {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 18px;
    margin: 36px 0 8px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: rise 0.7s ease-out 0.25s forwards;
  }

  .polaroid {
    background: var(--paper);
    padding: 14px 14px 30px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(78, 63, 82, 0.18);
    width: 190px;
    transform: rotate(-4deg);
  }

  .polaroid-photo {
    width: 100%;
    aspect-ratio: 2 / 3;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--blush), var(--lavender));
    border-radius: 2px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  .polaroid-photo img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
  }

  .polaroid-photo svg {
    width: 28px;
    height: 28px;
    opacity: 0.5;
  }

  .counter {
    margin: 40px 0 8px;
    opacity: 0;
    animation: rise 0.7s ease-out 0.35s forwards;
  }

  .counter-label {
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: var(--plum-soft);
    margin: 0 0 16px;
  }

  .counter-grid {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 14px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .counter-unit {
    background: var(--paper);
    border-radius: 14px;
    padding: 14px 10px;
    min-width: 70px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(78, 63, 82, 0.12);
  }

  .counter-value {
    font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
    font-size: 1.7rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--plum);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }

  .counter-unit-label {
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    color: var(--plum-soft);
    margin-top: 4px;
    text-transform: lowercase;
  }

  .signature {
    margin-top: 36px;
    font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    color: var(--gold);
    opacity: 0;
    animation: rise 0.7s ease-out 0.45s forwards;
  }

  @keyframes rise {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .mark, h1, .reveal-btn, .message, .polaroids, .signature {
      animation: none;
      opacity: 1;
      transform: none;
    }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="card">
    <div class="mark">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 40 40" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <path d="M20 34C20 34 4 24.5 4 13.8C4 8.6 8.2 4.5 13.3 4.5C16.3 4.5 18.9 6 20 8.4C21.1 6 23.7 4.5 26.7 4.5C31.8 4.5 36 8.6 36 13.8C36 24.5 20 34 20 34Z" fill="#D9A88F"/>
      </svg>
    </div>
    <h1>for yayang</h1>

    <button class="reveal-btn" id="revealBtn" type="button">tekan sini sayang</button>

    <div class="reveal-content" id="revealContent">
      <p class="message">saya minta maaf sayang sebab gaduh dengan sayang harini, semalam jugak<br>
saya taknak gaduh dengan sayang, saya sayang awak saya tak benci sayang pun.<br>
pasal keretapi sarong tu memang saya ada terlintas nak ajak sayang. saya taknak ganggu sayang sebab sayang baru pindah.<br>
lepastu saya minta maaf sebab marah marah sayang tadi harini, taknak cakap dengan sayang lepastu saya buat taktau kat sayang, saya sayang awak lagi sayang.<br>
lepastu mana ada saya malu dengan sayang, awak jangan risau la sayang saya tak malu pun dengan awak. orang tanya siapa pun saya akan tunjuk gambar saya dengan awak.<br>
mana ada awak tak cantik, awak cantik sayang. jangan risau la sayang. saya tak akan malu pun dengan sayang lepastu sayang jangan la bahasakan diri tu belen apa tadi sayang letak nama sayang tu tak baik la sayang.<br>
lepastu tadi yang saya suruh sayang senyap je diam tu sebab saya taknak la gaduh panjang panjang sebab nanti saya takut kita maki memaki<br>
and saya pun taknak la marah marah sangat kat sayang. pasal keretapi sarong tu jom la sayang pergi dengan saya, saya tak lebihkan dorang dari awak pun sayang. kalau awak ajak saya pergi pun saya on je sayang memang last year saya taknak pergi tapi tu last year sayang. Saya minta maaf sayang.</p>

      <div class="polaroids">
        <div class="polaroid">
          <div class="polaroid-photo">
            <img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Us together">
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="counter">
        <p class="counter-label">together since 20 June 2025</p>
        <div class="counter-grid">
          <div class="counter-unit">
            <div class="counter-value" id="c-days">0</div>
            <div class="counter-unit-label">days</div>
          </div>
          <div class="counter-unit">
            <div class="counter-value" id="c-hours">0</div>
            <div class="counter-unit-label">hours</div>
          </div>
          <div class="counter-unit">
            <div class="counter-value" id="c-minutes">0</div>
            <div class="counter-unit-label">minutes</div>
          </div>
          <div class="counter-unit">
            <div class="counter-value" id="c-seconds">0</div>
            <div class="counter-unit-label">seconds</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <p class="signature">— with love, always</p>
    </div>
  </div>

  <script>
    function revealMessage() {
      var btn = document.getElementById('revealBtn');
      var content = document.getElementById('revealContent');
      btn.style.display = 'none';
      content.classList.add('show');
    }

    document.getElementById('revealBtn').addEventListener('click', revealMessage);

    var relationshipStart = new Date('2025-06-20T00:00:00');

    function pad(n) {
      return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n;
    }

    function updateCounter() {
      var now = new Date();
      var diffMs = now - relationshipStart;
      if (diffMs < 0) diffMs = 0;

      var totalSeconds = Math.floor(diffMs / 1000);
      var days = Math.floor(totalSeconds / 86400);
      var hours = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 86400) / 3600);
      var minutes = Math.floor((totalSeconds % 3600) / 60);
      var seconds = totalSeconds % 60;

      document.getElementById('c-days').textContent = days;
      document.getElementById('c-hours').textContent = pad(hours);
      document.getElementById('c-minutes').textContent = pad(minutes);
      document.getElementById('c-seconds').textContent = pad(seconds);
    }

    updateCounter();
    setInterval(updateCounter, 1000);
  </script>
</body>
</html>
